summary: Kandal M Venture Limited filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing that Nasdaq formally notified the company on October 30, 2026 that it has regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement, after Class A ordinary shares closed at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from October 16 to October 29, 2026. The original deficiency letter dated December 22, 2025 carried a 180-day cure period later extended to December 21, 2026. The matter is now closed; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation are implicated.
